_meta.description: MODALITY1 curated ground-truth set for a mechanism-first, FAIL-SAFE intervention-MODALITY recommender. Generalizes MENDEL1 (germline-monogenic, 3 small-molecule-centric modes) to the FULL modality taxonomy across MANY disease classes (monogenic, cancer, autoimmune/inflammatory, cardiometabolic, neuro, ophthalmic, hematologic). Every row is a REAL, cited (target, disease, molecular mechanism, APPROVED intervention MODALITY) fact from an FDA/EMA approval or landmark trial. No fact is fabricated. The recommender predicts a MODALITY CLASS, not a molecule (the SMALL_MOLECULE branch still hits the affinity wall AFFINITY1/HIT2/B49/B65); triage-not-therapy; in-silico.

modality_taxonomy.SMALL_MOLECULE_INHIBITOR: small-molecule blockade of an over-active / gain-of-function druggable intracellular or membrane target
modality_taxonomy.SMALL_MOLECULE_ACTIVATOR: small-molecule that RESTORES/rescues function of a residual (misfolded/hypomorphic) protein or a stabilizable native-fold aggregation-prone protein: potentiator/corrector/pharmacological chaperone/cofactor/kinetic stabilizer
modality_taxonomy.MONOCLONAL_ANTIBODY: monoclonal antibody / biologic neutralizing or blocking an EXTRACELLULAR target (secreted ligand or cell-surface receptor ectodomain)
modality_taxonomy.ASO_siRNA: antisense oligonucleotide or siRNA acting at the RNA level: lowering a toxic/over-abundant transcript, or splice-switching
modality_taxonomy.ENZYME_PROTEIN_REPLACEMENT: delivery of the functional protein/enzyme (enzyme-replacement or factor/protein replacement) for a loss-of-function deficiency of a secreted, circulating, or systemically-accessible lysosomal protein
modality_taxonomy.GENE_THERAPY: gene addition (AAV / ex-vivo lentiviral / gene-corrected autologous cells) restoring a functional copy for a recessive loss-of-function of an intracellular/non-secreted target
modality_taxonomy.ABSTAIN: no single feasibility-determinable target-directed modality; the honest output is abstention (the fail-safe default, never a violation)

mechanism_definitions.GoF: activating / constitutive-activation gain-of-function of the causal protein
mechanism_definitions.overactivity: pathological over-activity or over-abundance of a normal (unmutated) protein whose reduction/blockade is therapeutic
mechanism_definitions.LoF_null: loss of function with little/no residual protein (deletion/nonsense/severe null)
mechanism_definitions.LoF: loss of function, mixed/hypomorphic alleles (residual amount variable)
mechanism_definitions.LoF_misfold: loss of function dominated by misfolding/hypomorph with residual protein amenable to chaperone/potentiator/cofactor rescue
mechanism_definitions.dominant_negative: mutant product poisons the wild-type product
mechanism_definitions.toxic_aggregation: toxic gain via misfolding/aggregation/polymerization or repeat expansion

feature_definitions.localization: UniProt subcellular location, coarsened: secreted | cell_surface | membrane (single-pass/multi-pass with the druggable handle INSIDE the cell, e.g. RTK kinase domain or ion channel) | intracellular (cytosol/nucleus/organelle) | lysosomal
feature_definitions.causal_node: causal_gene (drug target IS the disease protein) vs downstream_node (a druggable pathway node downstream of a LoF gene). NOTE: this seed contains only causal_gene rows; downstream-node modality reasoning (TSC2->mTOR, NF1->MEK, VHL->HIF2a) is validated in MENDEL1 and deliberately EXCLUDED here to keep the direct-target->modality mapping clean (a disclosed scope limit).
feature_definitions.bbb_cns: does effective treatment require crossing the blood-brain barrier / is the pathology CNS-restricted (a known objective property that governs enzyme-replacement feasibility)
feature_definitions.splice_addressable: is the loss-of-function molecularly addressable by a splice-switching ASO (in-frame exon skip) or a paralog splice target (objective molecular property; used ONLY in the feasibility matrix, NOT in the predictor, so it cannot leak into predictions)

_meta.provenance_note: Citations are FDA/EMA approvals and landmark trials the assembler verified (several PubMed-confirmed during assembly: givosiran/ENVISION Balwani NEJM 2020; lumasiran/ILLUMINATE-A Garrelfs NEJM 2021; riociguat/CHEST-1 Ghofrani NEJM 2013; sebelipase Burton NEJM 2015; mipomersen Raal Lancet 2010; atidarsagene Fumagalli Lancet 2022; betibeglogene Kwiatkowski Lancet 2024; etranacogene/HOPE-B Pipe NEJM 2023). Multi-modality targets (real phenomenon: several targets have >=2 approved modalities) carry the mechanism-canonical / landmark modality as true_modality and list alternatives in also_feasible. n=43 hand-verified; small n disclosed as a scope limit.
